rebuttals.topic: Gate bundle nen do gi: CODE/CONTENT split (architect) hay initial-load parse tu dist/index.html (pre-mortem)
rebuttals.myRound1Position: Gate aggregate mu voi initial-load; phai parse dist/index.html -> initial-load gz + so request critical-path, khong phai tong cong don.
rebuttals.argument: Hai de xuat KHONG mau thuan va KHONG thay the nhau — chung sua hai bien dang khac nhau, phai lam CA HAI. CODE/CONTENT split cua architect sua bien dang 'blog content creep lam phong so' — that va nen giu. Nhung no van la mot con so AGGREGATE: no cong byte, khong biet byte do duoc fetch EAGER hay LAZY. Bang chung song, tu verify tren dist hien tai: dist/index.html emit <link rel=modulepreload href=vendor-charts-BfXEjRFr.js> ngay trong <head>, va entry index-*.js chua static import `from"./vendor-charts-BfXEjRFr.js"` -> recharts (107.8 KB gz) bi trinh duyet fetch EAGER tren initial load cua MOI trang, du moi consumer (DuprRatingChart/PlayerProfile/DuprConnect/Admin+CreatorAnalytics) deu la lazy route. Architect tinh 'initial-load ~336 KB' bang cach cong cac chunk trong precache whitelist (solution-architect.md:24) va LOAI vendor-charts vi no khong nam trong globPatterns (vite.config.ts:104-124) — nhung trinh duyet van tai 107.8 KB do that. Nghia la: precache-membership != initial-load, va aggregate (ke ca CODE-aggregate) mu voi viec 107.8 KB nam eager hay lazy. Mot thay doi tuong lai keo 100 KB tu lazy vao shell eager se de CODE-aggregate NGUYEN VEN (cung tong byte, chi doi bucket) -> gate xanh -> first-paint regress khong ai thay: dung co che su co 3, gio da co bang chung thuc te. Nen: giu CODE/CONTENT split cua architect (chan content-creep) VA them mot gate parse dist/index.html (entry module + modulepreload + static-import de quy) do initial-load gz — bat buoc bo sung, khong thay the. He qua phu: vi recharts THAT SU eager, go recharts (Option B cua chinh architect) cat 107.8 KB khoi initial-load that -> first-paint win that, khong phai cosmetic nhu architect ket luan ('goal a coi nhu da dat, khong con don bay lon'); gate cua toi lo ra dieu nay, gate cua architect thi khong.
rebuttals.note: Khong mau thuan — bo sung. CODE-split can-nhung-khong-du. Initial-load gate bat buoc. Bang chung recharts eager la truong hop that chung minh aggregate/CODE-aggregate/precache-membership deu khong do duoc initial-load.

rebuttals.topic: react-dom co nam trong entry khong, va fix manualChunks co gay waterfall regression khong
rebuttals.myRound1Position: Su co 3 (xac suat CAO): keo react-dom khoi entry vao vendor-react them mot hop tuan tu tren critical path -> first load mobile VN cham hon trong khi gate xanh.
rebuttals.argument: Tu verify tren dist hien tai, do do cua architect dung: react-dom KHONG nam trong entry. Fingerprint react-dom (onRecoverableError) tren dist/assets: index-*.js = 0, vendor-react-*.js = 0, vendor-ui-*.js = 6 -> react-dom da nam trong vendor-ui, khong phai entry. Va dist/index.html modulepreload CA vendor-ui LAN vendor-react ngay trong <head> = ca hai deu initial-load; vite.config.ts:111-112 xac nhan ca hai trong precache whitelist. Vi react-dom von KHONG o entry, khong ton tai hanh dong 'keo react-dom RA KHOI entry' — co che tien de cua su co 3 cua toi la HU CAU. Doi react-dom giua vendor-ui <-> vendor-react = 0 KB net, ca hai deu da eager-preloaded => khong them hop tuan tu moi, khong waterfall moi. Luat cho phep hu cau hau qua, khong hu cau co che; co che nay khong dung nen toi CONCEDE. LUU Y phan gia tri con lai cua su co 3 (gate khong do initial-load — ap cho MOI thay doi bundle tuong lai) da tach sang D1 va toi HOLD o do.
rebuttals.note: CONCEDE dung tien de co che 'react-dom trong entry'. Gia tri metric-blindspot khong nam o day — no thuoc D1.
